headline: Guyana offers 50% bill cut after outage
summary: Thousands of Berbice electricity customers in Guyana will receive a 50% reduction on their November bills. The move follows a power outage lasting about 45 hours.
why: Electricity pricing and service reliability affect household costs and business operations in Guyana, a country whose energy sector is expanding. Utility bill decisions can have fiscal implications for the state-linked power provider.
